dataset.description: SYNCOP is the descriptive title for a semi-industrial set-up of Acartia tonsa cultures which will be tested for the addition of a prebiotic, a probiotic, and the combination of both. This is a collaboration between Ghent University (Belgium), NTNU (Norway) and a commercial partner CFEED (Norway).

format:
I will be collecting images (jpg or png, probably), sound files (probably mp4) and videos (mp4)
    I will be collecting DNA sequences (FASTQ) and creating bioinformatics outputs (FASTA, TSV, TXT)
    I will be collecting measurements from my aquaculture experiment in a spreadsheet

dmp.description: The purpose of this DMP is to provide an overview to data generated throughout the SYNCOP experiment, funded by AQUASERV PID grant 38468. This is a collaboration between Ghent University (Belgium), NTNU (Norway) and commercial partner CFEED (Norway). A prebiotic and probiotic were tested in semi-industrial cultures of the copepod Acartia tonsa.
